scope: Pure offline document-evidence gate; no impact classifier, collection, storage, route or rights grant
trusted_configuration: Fixed service verifier and independently selected before/after receipt IDs
Canonical server-owned scope, owner, watchlist/version, sorted slugs and complete source cohort
Exact matching catalog/curated inventory snapshot and explicit asOf
required_evidence: Both original signatures, cross-bindings and canonical source payloads verified under unchanged policies

Whole-report service capture window: check mode, no dry-run sources, at most2 checked sources,1 robots request and30000ms reported request duration; no checked source outside canonical job or uncounted current observation
One or two canonical URLs on one host, with every selected source present in both phases
Distinct executions/nonces, ordered completed captures within90days; no claim of adjacency or global latestness
checked_this_run HTTP200 reachable complete observation, captured projection, observation within execution
Before evidence fresh at its capture completion; after evidence fresh at asOf using existing isDue policy
Complete original UTF8 body supplement matching signed body hash and receivedBytes; never a preview reconstruction
Projection recomputed from full bytes under retained media/profile and exactly equal, including clipped previews
Exact nonempty quotation on UTF8 byte boundaries, linked only to declared profile step/source
Every emitted quote occurrence counts against one24word budget per URL across both phases and all steps
new_material_budget: UTF8 profile/quote/body-metadata canonical JSON plus raw supplement bytes <=65536; existing signed originals retain their existing limits
output_data: Bounded quotations and source/receipt/body hashes, offsets, dates and pointers
provenance_limit: Signatures endorse service assertions, not independent fetching, time, deployment identity, relevance, latestness or runtime behavior
abstention: Any missing, stale, unsupported, contradictory, unverifiable or over-budget selected evidence discards all requested quotes; never partial ready
activation: Unbound. No automatic body capture/retention, new entitlement, policy selection or public compatibility promise. Legacy originals remain unchanged.
